changedFiles.reason: Added selected lower-band catch-up targeting during prepare-mode readiness, emitted chunk/band stderr warnings, and blocked compact on catch-up failures instead of repairing legacy placeholder output.
Forwarded async lower-band compression dependencies into prepareAsyncThread so smart compact can use the configured catch-up provider path.
Added coverage for selected semantic lower-band catch-up success/failure and updated maintenance expectations away from placeholder regeneration.
Added smart compact coverage for selected semantic lower-band catch-up success/failure and updated the prepare-mode repair scenario to use canonical semantic chunks.
